g.text: What it does
Question
How Netra answers it
What did a company retire?
Every Verra and Gold Standard retirement since 2020 (342,012 records, 876 Mt),
grouped by the beneficiary and, for the largest buyers, by company group.
How much of it is likely real?
Tonnes × the share of real reductions that research found for that project type
(Probst et al. 2024), with the published range and a grade from A to E.
What does the company emit?
Its own reported figure, read from its primary report (79 company groups, 94.3% of
company tonnes), next to Climate TRACE's independent ownership-weighted estimate.
Who is hiding?
Anonymous, "Not Disclosed", reseller, wallet and untraceable accounts, labelled and
quantified.
Can the check be trusted later?
A hash of each published check and a Merkle root of its registry serial ranges are
written to the ClaimRegistry contract. A serial range claimed twice can be flagged
on-chain by anyone.
The web app has five views: Check (search a company or paste a claim, company result, and the live registry check),
Hidden buyers, Data (all company groups, sortable, with side-by-side comparison and downloads), About (story,
research, sources, limits) and Glossary (every term in plain English).
